title: In-car technology and upgraded feel
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly praise the car’s in-car technology, upgraded feel, and innovative comfort, while several other remarks mention technology without a clear evaluative stance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as packed with technology, innovative in feel, and comfortable or enjoyable to use and drive.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention upgraded technology, getting used to the tech, or isolated references to features without a clear overall judgment.

limitations: Several fragments are too brief or ambiguous to determine sentiment clearly.
Some examples loosely relate to innovation or upgrades rather than in-car technology specifically, so the topic is somewhat broad.
